html:
The Maithakari, or Mayi-Thakurti, were an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, around today's Cloncurry.

They spoke one of the Mayi languages, a small group now extinct, shared with the Mayi-Yapi, Mayi-Kutuna and Mayi-Kulan. To the west lived the Kalkadoon of the Mount Isa hills. Copper was found near Cloncurry in 1867, and cattle and mining camps took over their waterholes in the following decades.
sum: The Maithakari, or Mayi-Thakurti, were an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, around today's Cloncurry.
